toolkit.title: Gmail
toolkit.access: Doddy can list your recent emails (sender, subject, a short preview) and read one email aloud when you ask, after you say yes. It can write drafts, send an email, reply, forward, archive, mark read or unread, star, and move an email to Trash, each only after you tap the card that shows exactly what will happen. It never deletes email for good.

tools.name: check_email
tools.title: Check my email
tools.blurb: Lists your newest emails: sender, subject and a short preview. It doesn't open full messages.

tools.name: read_email
tools.title: Read an email
tools.blurb: Reads one email aloud when you ask, the newest that matches. Off until you switch it on.

tools.name: draft_email
tools.title: Draft an email
tools.blurb: Creates a draft in Gmail after you tap Create on the card. Doddy never sends it.

tools.name: draft_email_reply
tools.title: Draft a reply
tools.blurb: Creates a reply draft in an email's conversation, to its sender, after you tap Create on the card. Doddy never sends it. Off until you switch it on.

tools.name: send_email
tools.title: Send an email
tools.blurb: Sends an email from your Gmail after you tap Send on the card, which shows the recipient, subject and full text. Off until you switch it on.

tools.name: reply_to_email
tools.title: Send a reply
tools.blurb: Sends a reply in an email's conversation, to its sender, after you tap Send reply. Off until you switch it on.

tools.name: forward_email
tools.title: Forward an email
tools.blurb: Forwards one email, with its attachments, after you tap Forward on the card. Off until you switch it on.

tools.name: change_email
tools.title: Archive or mark email
tools.blurb: Archives, marks read or unread, or stars one email after you tap the card. Off until you switch it on.

tools.name: trash_email
tools.title: Move email to Trash
tools.blurb: Moves one email to Gmail's Trash after you tap the card. It can be restored for 30 days; Doddy never deletes for good. Off until you switch it on.

receipt.summary: Connected, but the access granted to Gmail is broader than Doddy needs, so Doddy won't use it. Disconnect and reconnect.
